description:
## 2.2.1

- feat: a scratch text box in Settings, so a change can be tried where it was made
- docs: the removal case is observed now, not argued
- docs: Bigger Toolbar confirmed on a device, and why twelve
- feat: an About section that says where this came from
- feat: patch descriptions that mention the ceiling they run into
- feat: the settings row says who wrote it
- feat: teaching an old keyboard new tricks
- feat: say what Flexboard is in Gboard's settings, not what it was
- docs: verify the channel model against morphe-manager, and name the gap
- build: make the gate one command, and stop the scanner lying
- docs: record the green gate that was not a gate
